title: 第一卷 第2431章 第四重庙宇第一卷 第2430章 尽得造化
content_zh:
第四重庙宇。
夏侯家对这里的探索已经很深入。
时间的堆砌，加上庞大资源的投入，第四重庙宇其实应该是拦不住夏侯家的脚步的。
甚至在上一次千神洞府开启之时，夏侯家就已经计划突破第四重庙宇，抵达最后一重庙宇，甚至是穿过阴阳庙，得到那最后一枚神名核晶。
对于已经掌握七枚神名核晶的夏侯家来说，这最后一枚，不至于轻易得到，但也不会是希望渺茫。
只是在上一次探索的过程中，却是出现了意外。
导致当时的阴阳庙突发异变。
阴阳之力的强度直线抬升，原本第四重庙宇的所有布置，全部改易，导致夏侯家在这里的投入顷刻间化为乌有，不得不从头开始。
而这还不止。
阴阳大道的变化导致通过第四重庙宇的难度同样暴涨，即便是夏侯家，也难以应付。
不得不拖到这一次的千神洞府开启。
而中间这段时间，夏侯家则是不停的投入研究，并且四处结交阴阳大道的强者，以制定针对阴阳庙的攻略。
林辰，也是夏侯家结交的强者之一。
但却是原本计划之外的，是叶蓁与林辰有了接触之后，这才将林辰纳入选项，但从始至终，林辰都不是唯一的一个，甚至不是最被看好的一个。
即便是叶蓁，也并非对林辰抱有最大期待，只是觉得是一个可能性。
所以林辰没有第一时间前往阴阳庙履行合作，叶蓁也并不在意。
其实在夏侯家的判断中，其实林辰一开始不来，那就不用来了，毕竟那时候已经不需要用到林辰，也不必让林辰来分一杯羹。
只不过现实情况却与预想的完全不同。
即便夏侯家反复进行了推演，准备极为充分，那些修炼阴阳大道的合作者，也没有一个是水货，全部都是真材实料。
但却架不住这第四重庙宇爆发出远超预计的力量！

阴阳乱流一出。
一切准备都化作了泡影，叶蓁等夏侯家强者悉数被困，那些阴阳大道的合作者，也都被阴阳乱流吞噬绞碎，尸骨无存。
夏侯家原本信心满满的计划，全部泡汤。
别说得到神名核晶，开启千神洞府的终极大秘，就是全身而退都显得困难重重。
夏侯家此刻是封锁了消息，不允许透露阴阳庙内的进展，但也不可能一直瞒下去，等到其余势力察觉到夏侯家现在的情况，那么夏侯家在别处的利益，只怕会受到冲击。
不可能再维持一家独大的局面。
所以夏侯家当下的处境，其实是十分凶险的。
夏侯徳始终不愿出手，的确有他不愿涉险的原因在，但同时，也的确需要他在外坐镇，以稳定人心。
“情况到现在还没有好转，也就是说，家族也已经束手无策”，夏侯休眉头紧皱。
他和林辰一同走向第四重庙宇。
这一路上，很顺畅。
content_en:
The fourth level temple.
The Xiahou family has already explored this place very deeply.
With the accumulation of time and the investment of huge resources, the fourth level temple should not be able to stop the Xiahou family.
Even when the Thousand Gods Cave was opened last time, the Xiahou family had already planned to break through the fourth level of the temple, reach the last level of the temple, and even pass through the Yin and Yang Temple to obtain the last god's name core crystal.
For the Xiahou family, which has already mastered seven divine name core crystals, this last one will not be easy to obtain, but it will not be a hopeless one.
But during the last exploration, something unexpected happened.
This led to sudden changes in the Yin Yang Temple at that time.
The intensity of the power of yin and yang increased sharply, and all the original layout of the fourth level temple was changed. As a result, the Xiahou family's investment here was instantly wiped out, and they had to start from scratch.
And that's not all.
The changes in the Yin-Yang Avenue have caused the difficulty of passing the fourth level of the temple to skyrocket, and even the Xiahou family has difficulty coping with it.
It had to be postponed until the opening of Thousand Gods Cave this time.
During this period of time, the Xiahou family continued to invest in research and made friends with powerful people from the Yin and Yang Avenue to formulate strategies for the Yin and Yang Temple.
Lin Chen is also one of the strong people the Xiahou family has made friends with.
But it was out of the original plan. It was after Ye Zhen came into contact with Lin Chen that she included Lin Chen as an option. But from beginning to end, Lin Chen was not the only one, or even the most promising one.
Even Ye Zhen didn't have the highest expectations for Lin Chen, she just thought it was a possibility.
So Lin Chen didn't go to Yin Yang Temple immediately to fulfill his cooperation, and Ye Zhen didn't care either.
In fact, according to the Xiahou family's judgment, if Lin Chen didn't come in the first place, then there was no need to come. After all, there was no need to use Lin Chen at that time, and there was no need for Lin Chen to get a share of the pie.
But the reality is completely different from what was expected.
Even though the Xiahou family had repeatedly conducted deductions and were extremely well prepared, none of the collaborators who practiced Yin Yang Dao were parallel imports, and all of them were genuine materials.
But he couldn't withstand the strength of the fourth level temple that exceeded expectations!
The turbulent flow of yin and yang came out.
All preparations were in vain. Ye Zhen and other powerful members of the Xiahou family were all trapped. Those collaborators on the Yin-Yang Avenue were also swallowed and crushed by the turbulent currents of Yin-Yang, and no bones were left.
All the Xiahou family's confident plans came to nothing.
Not to mention obtaining the God's Name Core Crystal and unlocking the ultimate secret of the Thousand Gods Cave, even escaping intact seems to be very difficult.
The Xiahou family has blocked information at the moment and is not allowed to reveal the progress in the Yin Yang Temple, but it is impossible to keep it a secret. When other forces become aware of the Xiahou family's current situation, the Xiahou family's interests elsewhere may be affected.
It is impossible to maintain the situation where one company is the only one.
Therefore, the current situation of the Xiahou family is actually very dangerous.
Xiahou De has always been reluctant to take action. There is indeed a reason why he does not want to take risks, but at the same time, he does need to sit outside to stabilize people's hearts.
"The situation has not improved yet, which means that the family is at its wits' end." Xia Houxiu frowned.
He and Lin Chen walked towards the fourth level temple together.
This journey has been smooth.
